voice: Gravel; dry Delhi Hindi; the only person who calls Daya by his real name; softer when sober

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Square face, heavy lids, broken veins on the nose, red-rimmed eyes, a deep scar over the left ear

skin.description: Wheatish; red cheeks and eye whites from drink; deep crow's feet
skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: Linen shirt with sleeves rolled; khaki chinos; leather loafers (Dubai) or kurta and loose trousers (Karachi)
outfits.monsoon: Dark shirt; cotton trousers; a light rain jacket
outfits.winter: Tweed or corduroy jacket; wool scarf
outfits.by_act: A3-A4=Dubai: pressed shirts, always a collar; A5=Karachi: stained shalwar kameez and a knee brace under it; the last day: the same, plus the lanyard of a fake fishing licence

accessories: Steel-and-neoprene knee brace on the RIGHT knee; a hip flask (fictional label); worn Casio-style watch; a battered notebook; reading glasses
tells: Taps two fingers on the brace when he does not want to say something; always checks exits
gait_notes: Right knee wrecked: weight on the left, right leg swung slightly out and locked; stiff and cautious on stairs and slopes; sits whenever he can; the limp is permanent and slows him to 75% of normal (pairs with the injury rules of the vitals component)
sensitivity: His drinking is a wound, not a joke; his death in Act 5 is the emotional climax and is not staged for shock.
